chunks.title: Electrical Shock Hazard
chunks.content: Never immerse the motor body, cord, or plug in water or other liquid; keep hands and utensils away from the blade while chopping.

scenarios.condition: If the appliance or cord contacts water or if hands/utensils are near the moving blade
steps: Never place the base in water
Keep hands and utensils away from the cutting blade while it is running
A scraper may only be used when the appliance is not running

chunks.title: Blade Handling and Cover Interlock
chunks.content: The blade is sharp and must be handled carefully; never place the blade on the base without the bowl in place, and never defeat the cover interlock mechanism.

scenarios.condition: When assembling or attempting to run the unit
steps: Always put the work bowl in place before adding the blade
Ensure the lid/cover is securely locked before operating
Do not attempt to bypass or defeat the lid interlock

chunks.title: General Use Precautions
chunks.content: Turn off and unplug the appliance before assembling, disassembling, or cleaning; do not use outdoors, let cord hang over edges, or use damaged units.

chunks.title: Supervision Around Children and Vulnerable Users
chunks.content: This appliance is not intended for use by children or persons with reduced physical, sensory, or mental capabilities unless closely supervised.

chunks.title: Attachments and Damaged Cord Warning
chunks.content: Do not use attachments not sold by the manufacturer, and do not operate the appliance if the cord or plug is damaged or the unit malfunctioned, was dropped, or damaged; return to an Authorized Service Center.

chunks.title: Electrical Requirements
chunks.content: Operates at 120V, 60Hz with a polarized plug; do not modify the plug, and the short cord is intentional to reduce tripping/entanglement risk.

chunks.title: Parts and Accessories
chunks.content: The Food Chopper KFC3516 includes a lid with drizzle basin and pulse/on button, work bowl with handle and pour spout, stainless steel multipurpose blade, and heavy-duty base with chop/purée lever and cord wrap.

chunks.title: Chop and Purée Recommendations
chunks.content: Use the chart to determine preparation, max quantity, and setting (Chop or Purée) for raw/cooked produce, liquids, meat, herbs, bread, and nuts; cut large items to 1-inch pieces first.

rows: Place dry/thicker ingredients in bowl, add oils via drizzle basin
Up to 1/2 lb (227g) at a time
Break into pieces that fit the bowl

chunks.title: Do Not Process Warning
chunks.content: Never process coffee beans or hard spices such as nutmeg, as this may damage the Food Chopper.

chunks.title: Before First Use Washing
chunks.content: Before using for the first time, wash the work bowls, lids, and blade in hot soapy water or the top rack of a dishwasher.

chunks.title: Disassembling the Food Chopper
chunks.content: Unplug the unit, rotate the lid clockwise to unlock and lift off, pull the blade straight up, then rotate the work bowl clockwise to unlock and lift it off the base.

chunks.title: Assembling and Running the Food Chopper
chunks.content: With the unit unplugged, lock the work bowl handle onto the base by rotating it 90° counterclockwise, fit the blade onto the shaft, add ingredients cut to 1-inch pieces, place and lock the lid, then slide the Chop/Purée lever and press Pulse/On to start; use rapid pulsing for a coarse chop.

chunks.title: Using the Drizzle Basin and Pour Spout
chunks.content: Lock the lid, pulse to get ingredients moving, slowly pour liquids like oil into the drizzle basin to emulsify dressings or mayonnaise, then remove the lid after processing to pour out the mixture through the pour spout.

chunks.title: Cleaning and Storage
chunks.content: Unplug the unit, wash the work bowl, lid, and blade in hot soapy water or the top dishwasher rack, wipe the base with a damp cloth (never immersing it), and wrap the cord counterclockwise around the base for storage.

chunks.title: Food Chopper Won't Operate
chunks.content: If the chopper fails to run, verify it is plugged in, the bowl and lid are properly locked, use a rapid pulsing motion rather than holding the button, unplug and replug, and check the circuit breaker/fuse.

rows: Is the Food Chopper plugged in?
Are the bowl and lid properly aligned and locked?
Press Pulse/On rapidly, do not hold continuously

chunks.title: Warranty Overview
chunks.content: One-year full warranty from date of purchase for units used in the 50 US states, DC, Puerto Rico, and Canada, covering hassle-free replacement or parts/labor for defects.

tasks.title: Wash Removable Parts Before First Use
tasks.description: Wash the work bowl, lid, and blade in hot soapy water or the dishwasher before using the chopper for the first time.
tasks.justification: Ensures no manufacturing residue or dust contacts food on first use.
tasks.instructions_text: Remove the lid, blade, and work bowl. Wash them in hot, soapy water or place them in the top rack of a dishwasher. Rinse and dry before reassembling.

tasks.title: Clean Work Bowl, Lid, and Blade After Use
tasks.description: Wash the work bowl, lid, and blade after each use to remove food residue.
tasks.justification: Leftover food residue can harden, cause odors, or affect blade performance on next use.
tasks.instructions_text: Unplug the chopper and remove the work bowl, lid, and blade. Wash these parts in hot soapy water or place them in the top rack of the dishwasher, then rinse and dry.

tasks.title: Wipe Down the Base
tasks.description: Wipe the heavy-duty base with a damp cloth to remove spills and residue.
tasks.justification: Prevents buildup of grime on the motor housing; the base cannot be washed like the bowl and lid.
tasks.instructions_text: Wipe the base clean with a damp cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners and never immerse the base in water.

tasks.title: Wrap Cord for Storage
tasks.description: Wrap the power cord counterclockwise around the base after cleaning for tidy storage.
tasks.justification: Keeps the cord organized and prevents tangling or tripping hazards during storage.
tasks.instructions_text: After cleaning, wrap the power cord counterclockwise around the base of the unit for convenient storage.

deep_clean.title: After-Use Cleaning
steps: Remove the work bowl, lid, and blade
Wash removable parts in the top rack of a dishwasher, or in hot soapy water; rinse and dry
Wipe the base with a damp cloth only; never immerse it in water
Wrap the cord counterclockwise around the base and reassemble for storage
